new_material_candidates.name: MemBuilder: Reinforcing LLMs for Long-Term Memory Construction via Attributed Dense Rewards
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Trains memory construction with attributed dense rewards and component-level contribution weighting, distinct from fixed retrieval and procedural-memory systems.

new_material_candidates.name: MemPro: Agentic Memory Systems as Evolvable Programs
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Treats the full memory construction-retrieval pipeline, including executable code and prompts, as an evolvable program under failure-mode-guided refinement.

new_material_candidates.name: MetaMem: Evolving Meta-Memory for Knowledge Utilization through Self-Reflective Symbolic Optimization
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Optimizes an explicit meta-memory of transferable knowledge-utilization experience using self-reflective symbolic updates.

new_material_candidates.name: MemSkill: Learning and Evolving Memory Skills for Self-Evolving Agents
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Replaces fixed memory operations with learned, reusable and evolvable memory skills, including transfer evaluation across datasets and base models.
